title: A meta-analysis of the effect of generative AI on productivity and learning in programming

Limitations: The search covers 2019-2025, not 2026 tools. Standardized effects combine unlike outcomes and cannot be read as percentage gains or evidence of equivalence in learning. Version: May 2026 v1 preprint; productivity 95% CI 0.09-0.58, learning g=0.14 with CI -0.18 to 0.47. No pooled effect is calculated by our review. Persistent identifier: arXiv:2605.04779
